class.name: AudioStreamOpenMPT
class.brief_description: AudioStream for playing tracker music files (MOD, XM, S3M, IT, and 40+ formats).

method.name: get_artist
method.description: Returns the artist/author name from the module metadata, or an empty string if not available.

method.name: get_channel_names
method.description: Returns an array of channel names defined in the module.

method.name: get_instrument_names
method.description: Returns an array of instrument names defined in the module.

method.name: get_message
method.description: Returns the song message or comment from the module metadata, or an empty string if not available.

method.name: get_num_channels
method.description: Returns the number of channels in the module.

method.name: get_num_instruments
method.description: Returns the number of instruments in the module.

method.name: get_num_orders
method.description: Returns the number of orders (song positions) in the module. Orders define the sequence of patterns to play.

method.name: get_num_patterns
method.description: Returns the number of patterns in the module.

method.name: get_num_samples
method.description: Returns the number of samples in the module.

method.name: get_sample_names
method.description: Returns an array of sample names defined in the module.

method.name: get_title
method.description: Returns the song title from the module metadata, or an empty string if not available.

method.name: load_from_data
method.description: Loads tracker music from a PackedByteArray. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an error code on failure. Useful for loading modules from memory or downloaded content.

method.name: load_from_file

members.member: The raw module data as a PackedByteArray.
The sample rate for audio playback. Automatically set to match AudioServer's mix rate.
